messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front-facing shape and the back view for the back-facing shape. Transfer only the hairstyle; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's original hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands on a wet surface, initially still, then begins to sway his hips and arms in a slow dance-like motion before returning to a standing position.","camera":"The camera is static, positioned at a medium distance behind the subject, capturing a full-body view.","clothing":"He wears a white sleeveless tank top with a pink palm tree graphic on the back, light blue shorts, and pink slide sandals.","hair_color":"Unclear, as the head is shaved.","hairstyle":"Shaved head.","identity":"A muscular, dark-skinned man is seen from behind, with a shaved head and a small tattoo on the back of his neck.","scene":"The setting is a futuristic urban plaza with a large, glowing circular neon structure and a glass-walled building in the background, with city skyscrapers visible in the distance."},"uncertain":["hair_color"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The man's head changed from a shaved head to a short, dark, textured hairstyle with a slightly fuller top and tapered sides, visible throughout the clip. Clothing, body, motion, camera, and background remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the man's hair to match the reference hairstyle, transferring only the hairstyle while preserving his original hair color and all other video elements.
uncertain: Whether the new hairstyle closely matches the reference front and back shapes, since the video is mostly rear-facing and the hair is small in frame.
unexpected_changes: The new hair appears dark/black, while the source hair color was not clearly visible on the shaved head.
